"""TOML config loading and precedence handling."""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import tomllib
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Mapping


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ResearchConfig:
    proof_lab_root: Path | None = None
    codex_kit_root: Path | None = None
    state_dir: Path = Path.home() / ".research-router"
    timezone: str | None = None
    user_agent: str | None = None
    config_path: Path | None = None
    write_policy: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    logging: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    thresholds: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    topics: dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)


def default_config_path(repo_root: Path) -> Path | None:
    candidate = repo_root / "configs" / "research.toml"
    return candidate if candidate.exists() else None


def load_config_file(path: Path | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if path is None:
        return {}
    with path.expanduser().open("rb") as handle:
        data = tomllib.load(handle)
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError(f"config must be a TOML table: {path}")
    return data


def resolve_config(
    *,
    repo_root: Path,
    config_path: Path | None = None,
    env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None,
    overrides: Mapping[str, str | None] | None = None,
) -> ResearchConfig:
    """Resolve config using overrides, env vars, config file, then defaults."""
    env = os.environ if env is None else env
    overrides = {} if overrides is None else overrides
    selected_config = config_path or (Path(env["RESEARCH_CONFIG"]) if env.get("RESEARCH_CONFIG") else None)
    selected_config = selected_config or default_config_path(repo_root)
    raw = load_config_file(selected_config)
    paths = raw.get("paths", {}) if isinstance(raw.get("paths", {}), dict) else {}

    proof_lab = first_non_empty(
        overrides.get("proof_lab_root"),
        env.get("PROOF_LAB_ROOT"),
        paths.get("proof_lab_root"),
    )
    codex_kit = first_non_empty(
        overrides.get("codex_kit_root"),
        env.get("CODEX_KIT_ROOT"),
        paths.get("codex_kit_root"),
    )
    state_dir = first_non_empty(
        overrides.get("state_dir"),
        env.get("RESEARCH_STATE_DIR"),
        paths.get("state_dir"),
        str(Path.home() / ".research-router"),
    )

    return ResearchConfig(
        proof_lab_root=Path(proof_lab).expanduser() if proof_lab else None,
        codex_kit_root=Path(codex_kit).expanduser() if codex_kit else None,
        state_dir=Path(state_dir).expanduser(),
        timezone=first_non_empty(env.get("RESEARCH_TIMEZONE"), raw.get("timezone")),
        user_agent=first_non_empty(env.get("RESEARCH_USER_AGENT"), raw.get("user_agent")),
        config_path=selected_config,
        write_policy=dict(raw.get("write_policy", {})),
        logging=dict(raw.get("logging", {})),
        thresholds=dict(raw.get("thresholds", {})),
        topics=dict(raw.get("topics", {})),
    )


def first_non_empty(*values: Any) -> str | None:
    for value in values:
        if value is None:
            continue
        text = str(value).strip()
        if text:
            return text
    return None

def initialize_database(db_path: Path | str) -> None:
    path = Path(db_path)
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(path)) as conn:
        with conn:
            conn.executescript(SCHEMA_SQL)
            migrate_database(conn)


def migrate_database(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    """Apply tiny additive migrations for existing v0 databases."""
    source_columns = table_columns(conn, "sources")
    additions = {
        "topic": "TEXT",
        "source_kind": "TEXT",
        "source_type": "TEXT",
        "local_file": "TEXT",
        "why": "TEXT",
    }
    for name, sql_type in additions.items():
        if name not in source_columns:
            conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE sources ADD COLUMN {name} {sql_type}")


def table_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str) -> set[str]:
    rows = conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table})").fetchall()
    return {str(row[1]) for row in rows}


def existing_tables(db_path: Path | str) -> set[str]:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(db_path)) as conn:
        rows = conn.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'").fetchall()
    return {row[0] for row in rows}


def has_required_tables(db_path: Path | str) -> bool:
    return set(REQUIRED_TABLES).issubset(existing_tables(db_path))


def insert_run(
    db_path: Path | str,
    *,
    run_id: str,
    command: str,
    args: dict[str, Any],
    started_at: str,

"""Manual source capture without fetching or proof-lab writes."""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlsplit, urlunsplit

from ..guards import redact_secrets, safe_slug
from ..logging_jsonl import utc_now

ALLOWED_SOURCE_TYPES = {
    "primary",
    "secondary",
    "anecdote",
    "marketing",
    "repo",
    "docs",
    "forum",
    "video",
    "job_post",
    "paper",
    "unknown",
}

PREVIEW_LIMIT = 1000


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ManualSource:
    source_id: str
    source_kind: str
    topic: str
    platform: str
    source_type: str
    url: str | None
    local_file: str | None
    title: str
    author: str | None
    published_at: str | None
    captured_at: str
    content_hash: str
    why: str | None
    preview_excerpt: str
    duplicate: dict[str, str] | None = None

    def to_db_row(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "source_id": self.source_id,
            "topic": self.topic,
            "source_kind": self.source_kind,
            "source_type": self.source_type,
            "local_file": self.local_file,
            "why": self.why,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "url": self.url,
            "title": self.title,
            "author": self.author,
            "published_at": self.published_at,
            "captured_at": self.captured_at,
            "content_hash": self.content_hash,
        }

    def to_output_dict(self) -> dict[str, object]:
        return {
            "source_id": self.source_id,
            "source_kind": self.source_kind,
            "topic": self.topic,
            "platform": self.platform,
            "source_type": self.source_type,
            "url": redact_secrets(self.url or ""),
            "local_file": redact_secrets(self.local_file or ""),
            "title": self.title,
            "author": self.author,
            "published_at": self.published_at,
            "captured_at": self.captured_at,
            "content_hash": self.content_hash,
            "why": self.why,
            "duplicate": self.duplicate,
        }


def is_url(value: str) -> bool:
    return value.startswith(("http://", "https://"))


def normalize_url(value: str) -> str:
    parts = urlsplit(value.strip())
    if parts.scheme not in {"http", "https"} or not parts.netloc:
        raise ValueError("URL must start with http:// or https:// and include a host")
    return urlunsplit((parts.scheme.lower(), parts.netloc.lower(), parts.path or "", parts.query, ""))


def detect_source_kind(value: str) -> str:
    if is_url(value):
        return "url"
    if Path(value).expanduser().exists():
        return "file"
    raise ValueError("source must be an http(s) URL or an existing local file path")


def sha256_text(value: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def sha256_file(path: Path) -> str:
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with path.open("rb") as handle:
        for chunk in iter(lambda: handle.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
            digest.update(chunk)
    return digest.hexdigest()


def read_preview(path: Path, limit: int = PREVIEW_LIMIT) -> str:
    with path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read(limit)


def infer_platform(source_kind: str, platform: str | None, normalized_url: str | None) -> str:
    if platform:
        return safe_slug(platform, max_length=32)
    if source_kind == "url" and normalized_url:
        host = urlsplit(normalized_url).netloc
        return safe_slug(host.replace("www.", ""), max_length=32)
    return source_kind


def generate_source_id(*, captured_at: str, platform_or_kind: str, hash_basis: str) -> str:
    date = captured_at[:10].replace("-", "")
    return f"src-{date}-{safe_slug(platform_or_kind, max_length=32)}-{hash_basis[:8]}"


def build_manual_source(
    source_input: str,
    *,
    topic: str,
    platform: str | None = None,
    title: str | None = None,
    author: str | None = None,
    published_at: str | None = None,
    source_type: str = "unknown",
    why: str | None = None,
    captured_at: str | None = None,
) -> ManualSource:
    if source_type not in ALLOWED_SOURCE_TYPES:
        allowed = ", ".join(sorted(ALLOWED_SOURCE_TYPES))
        raise ValueError(f"source_type must be one of: {allowed}")
    if not topic.strip():
        raise ValueError("--topic is required")
    captured = captured_at or utc_now()
    source_kind = detect_source_kind(source_input)

    if source_kind == "url":
        normalized = normalize_url(source_input)
        content_hash = sha256_text(normalized)
        platform_value = infer_platform(source_kind, platform, normalized)
        source_id = generate_source_id(
            captured_at=captured,
            platform_or_kind=platform_value,
            hash_basis=content_hash,
        )
        return ManualSource(
            source_id=source_id,
            source_kind=source_kind,
            topic=topic,
            platform=platform_value,
            source_type=source_type,
            url=normalized,
            local_file=None,
            title=title or normalized,
            author=author,
            published_at=published_at,
            captured_at=captured,
            content_hash=content_hash,
            why=why,
            preview_excerpt="",
        )

    path = Path(source_input).expanduser().resolve()
    if not path.is_file():
        raise ValueError("local source path must be a file")
    content_hash = sha256_file(path)
    platform_value = infer_platform(source_kind, platform, None)
    source_id = generate_source_id(
        captured_at=captured,
        platform_or_kind=platform_value,
        hash_basis=content_hash,
    )
    return ManualSource(
        source_id=source_id,
        source_kind=source_kind,
        topic=topic,
        platform=platform_value,
        source_type=source_type,
        url=None,
        local_file=str(path),
        title=title or path.name,
        author=author,
        published_at=published_at,
        captured_at=captured,
        content_hash=content_hash,
        why=why,
        preview_excerpt=read_preview(path),
    )


def with_duplicate(source: ManualSource, duplicate: dict[str, str] | None) -> ManualSource:
    values = {**source.__dict__, "duplicate": duplicate}
    if duplicate:
        values["source_id"] = duplicate["source_id"]
    return ManualSource(**values)


def render_raw_source_preview(source: ManualSource) -> str:
    location = source.url or source.local_file or ""
    quote = source.preview_excerpt.strip().replace("\n", " ")
    if quote:
        quote = quote[:300]
    else:
        quote = "Short quote only. Include context. Do not store large copied blocks."

    lines = [
        f"# Raw Source: {source.title or location}",
        "",
        "## Source",
        f"- Source ID: {source.source_id}",
        f"- Platform: {source.platform}",
        f"- URL: {source.url or ''}",
        f"- Local file: {source.local_file or ''}",
        f"- Author / org: {source.author or ''}",
        f"- Published: {source.published_at or ''}",
        f"- Captured: {source.captured_at}",
        f"- Source type: {source.source_type}",
        f"- Content hash: {source.content_hash}",
        "- Incentive / bias:",
        "- Recency:",
        "",
        "## Why captured",
        f"- Topic: {source.topic}",
        f"- Trigger: {source.why or ''}",
        "- Related project:",
        "",
        "## Extracted evidence",
        "| Claim / observation | Exact evidence | Source location | Evidence grade | Confidence |",
        "|---|---|---|---|---|",
        "",
        "## Quotes / receipts",
        f"> {quote}",
        "",
        "## What changed recently",
        "-",
        "",
        "## Hype vs real",
        "- Real:",
        "- Hype / uncertain:",
        "",
        "## Assumptions",
        "-",
        "",
        "## Follow-up checks",
        "-",
        "",
        "## Decision",
        "- Keep | discard | verify | use in synthesis",
        "",
        "## Next action",
        "-",
    ]
    if source.duplicate:
        lines = [
            f"[WARN] duplicate source: {source.duplicate['source_id']} captured at {source.duplicate['captured_at']}",
            "",
        ] + lines
    return redact_secrets("\n".join(lines))


def output_json(source: ManualSource, *, status: str) -> str:
    payload = {"status": status, "source": source.to_output_dict()}
    return redact_secrets(json.dumps(payload, indent=2, sort_keys=True))
